name: Phil Weiser
summary: Philip Jacob Weiser (born May 10, 1968) is an American attorney and politician who is the governor-elect of Colorado. He has served as the attorney general of Colorado since 2019. He is the Hatfield professor of law and telecommunications, executive director and founder of the Silicon Flatirons Center for Law, Technology, and Entrepreneurship, and dean emeritus at the University of Colorado Law School.
